description: USPCASE(b)-118: Combinations of Extreme Scenarios of Solar, Wind, and Hydro Variations in Peak Load Month for a Modified NREL 118 Bus Test System is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Muhammad Usama Waqar, Kashif Imran (National University of Sciences and Technology). This USPCASE(b)-118 dataset is a modified version of renewable integrated IEEE-118 bus system by NREL. It involves a total of eight scenarios covering extreme high and low generation combinations of hydro, wind, and solar in peak load month under high load operating conditions. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
